description: This file defines the CursorStatement class, which extends AbstractCursorHandler, providing JDBC cursor handling capabilities with transaction management, resource cleanup, and method invocation handling for database cursors in the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: CursorStatement
classes.description: A class that manages database cursor operations and transaction boundaries, extending AbstractCursorHandler to facilitate JDBC cursor interactions.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Handles method invocations on the cursor object, managing SQL operations like close, executeQuery, getMoreResults, and cursor configuration.

methods.name: newCursorStatement
methods.description: Factory method to create a new CursorStatement wrapped as a Statement object.

methods.name: newCursorPreparedStatement
methods.description: Factory method to create a new CursorStatement wrapped as a PreparedStatement object.
